description: This PHP source file generates a report of test cases created per user within a specific project in the TestLink test management system. It includes functions for initializing the user interface, handling report results, CSV file creation, and argument sanitization. The file references several external classes and scripts related to TestLink's configuration and UI components.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: An instance of a Smarty templating class used for rendering templates.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class for managing test projects, used here to retrieve test project data.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class for handling extended tables in the UI, allowing custom behaviors, grouping, and sorting.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI settings based on the action parameter, including input, result, or CSV download mode.

methods.name: initializeGuiForResult
methods.description: Prepares the GUI with test case creation results, retrieving data and formatting the output table.

methods.name: initGuiForCSVDownload
methods.description: Prepares and initiates CSV file creation for test case data, delivering it as a download.

methods.name: initializeGuiForInput
methods.description: Sets up input form options and default values for report generation inputs.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Retrieves and sanitizes input arguments from request/session for report generation.

methods.name: sanitizeDates
methods.description: Validates and cleans date inputs to ensure correct format.

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Defines columns used in the main report table, including labels and widths.

methods.name: getCSVColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Defines column headers for the CSV export of the report.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the user has the necessary rights to view test plan metrics.
